Why Sony Interactive Entertainment? 

 Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

 Why PlayStation? 

 Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. 

 The Direct to Consumer (D2C) Data Science organization comprises Data Science, Data Engineering and ML Engineering practices. D2C Data Science helps PlayStation grow and operate its digital business across commerce, subscriptions, payments, lifecycle experiences and player-facing services. We partner with product, engineering, finance, marketing and operations teams to turn experimentation, forecasting, AI and production-quality measurement into better player experiences.  

 Role overview: 

 Within D2C Data Science, the D2C ML Engineering team is the center of excellence for machine learning engineering. We build and operate the in-house machine learning platform that powers production decisions across the D2C portfolio, including fraud detection, payment authorization optimization, and account security decisions. 

  

 This is a hands-on engineering role combining cloud infrastructure operations with software development for platform tooling, automation and integrations. You will maintain and improve our AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure alongside the team, taking ownership of defined components or improvements within our existing architecture. Working with ML engineers and data scientists, you will help keep the machine learning platform reliable, observable and easy to maintain. 

 This role follows a hybrid working arrangement, with work primarily performed remotely and attendance at the San Diego office as needed. 

 What you'll be doing: 

 
 Develop and maintain backend services that support ML workflows and integrate the platform with other systems. 

 Reduce manual operational work and improve platform reliability through automation, tooling and service integrations. 

 Maintain and improve AWS infrastructure using Terraform within the team’s existing architecture, with a focus on repeatable deployments and maintainable configuration. 

 Operate and improve our EKS/Kubernetes environments alongside the team to scale with demand and maintain high availability and reliability, meeting agreed service-level targets. 

 Improve monitoring and alerting, investigate production issues, and implement fixes that reduce recurring incidents and manual work. 

 Be part of a time zone-based on-call rotation (no nights) for the platform and the services it serves. 

 
 What we're looking for: 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, with 3+ years of relevant experience 

 Strong software engineering foundations, with experience building, deploying and supporting production systems using Python or Java, including CI/CD, monitoring and troubleshooting. 

 Ability to use AI-assisted development tools effectively, assess their output, and validate changes through appropriate testing and monitoring. 

 Hands-on experience operating Kubernetes workloads and managing cloud infrastructure with Terraform, with practical knowledge of AWS. 

 Strong communication skills and the ability to work with engineers and data scientists across a globally distributed team. 

 
 Desirable skills: 

 
 AWS certification (e.g. Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer). 

 Experience with Snowflake or large-scale SQL analytics workloads. 

 Interest in machine learning workflows and the infrastructure used to deploy and operate models. 

 Interest in applying AI and agentic approaches to infrastructure automation and production operations. 

 At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.
 
Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. 
 
In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click  here to learn more. 

  

 The estimated base pay range for this role is listed below.
 $150,100 — $225,100 USD 


 Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

 Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice (where applicable) for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

 Equal Opportunity Statement: 

 Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category. 

 We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.  

 Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.
